t5106.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records ʿAmr ibn Muḥammad ibn Bukayr al-Nāqid, Abū ʿUthmān al-Baghdādī who settled in al-Raqqah, as reliable and a ḥāfiẓ though he erred in a hadith, of the tenth generation, dying in 232 AH.
as: Reliable and a ḥāfiẓ, but he erred in a hadith.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
ʿAmr al-Nāqid took care to speak truthfully.
حجاج بن الشاعر, quoted by al-Mizzī
ʿAmr took care to speak the truth.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما هو من أهل الكذب، هو صدوق.
He was not someone who lies, and he was truthful.
الحسين بن فهم, quoted by al-Mizzī
عمرو الناقد ثقة، ثبت صاحب حديث، وقد كتب عنه أهل بغداد كتابا كبيرا، وكان من الحفاظ المعدودين، وكان فقيها
ʿAmr al-Nāqid is reliable, precise and a hadith scholar. The Baghdadis wrote a large book from him. He was counted among the hadith masters and was a jurist.

t7180.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Nufayʿ ibn al-Ḥārith al-Thaqafī, Abū Bakra, a Companion well known by his kunya; he accepted Islam at al-Ṭāʾif, settled in Basra and died there in 51 or 52.
as: A Companion well known by his kunya.
كان من خيار أصحاب النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
He was among the best of the Prophet’s Companions.
الحافظ أبو نعيم الأصبهاني, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان رجلا صالحا، ورعا، آخى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بينه وبين أبي برزة
He was upright and scrupulous, and God’s Messenger established brotherhood between him and Abū Barzah.
Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyib, quoted by al-Mizzī
واستتاب أبا بكرة فأبى وأقام، فلم يقبل شهادته، وكان أفضل القوم
ʿUmar asked Abū Bakrah to retract and repent. He refused and stood by his statement, so his testimony was not accepted. He was the best of the group.
He was among the distinguished Companions.
He was among the distinguished Companions.
وكان مثل النصل من العبادة، حتى مات
Worship left him thin as a blade, and he remained so until his death.
الحسن البصري, quoted by Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr
لم ينزل البصرة من الصحابة ممن سكنها أفضل من عمران بن حصين وأبى بكرة
Among the Companions who settled in Basra, none was more distinguished than ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn and Abū Bakrah.
He was among the distinguished and upright Companions.
وكان أبو بكرة من فضلاء أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وصالحيهم
Abū Bakrah was among the distinguished and upright Companions of the Prophet.
وكان أبو بكرة كثير العبادة حتى مات
Abū Bakrah worshipped much until his death.
لم ينزل البصرة من الصحابة، ممن سكنها، أفضل من عمران بن حصين، وأبي بكرة
Among the Companions who settled in Basra, none was more distinguished than ʿImrān ibn Ḥuṣayn and Abū Bakrah.
The Prophet ﷺ, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
He is the freedman of God and His Messenger.
